title: Lightly Toasted Irish Bread Toast
description: A nutty and crispy Irish dish featuring toasted bread, perfect for a low-carb friendly snack, with a festive touch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the Irish bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Butter each slice of bread on both sides.
Sprinkle garlic powder, salt, and black pepper evenly over the bread slices.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until lightly toasted.
While the bread is baking, saute the onions in a pan with a little butter until caramelized.
Once the bread is done, remove it from the oven and top each slice with grated cheddar cheese, sauteed onions, and chopped scallions.
Return the bread to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
